name: Leapfrog Engineering Services
summary: Leapfrog Engineering Services Limited engages in engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning services in India and internationally. The company offers engineering solutions in the fields of electrical, instrumentation, industrial automation, fire protection and safety systems, modular substation, building automation systems and HVAC, and enterprise solutions. It serves to various industries including oil and gas, metal and minerals, mining, pharmaceuticals, cement, industrials, hospitals, power and telecommunication, food processing, chemicals and fertilizers, infrastructure, solar and renewable energy, and commercial complexes. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Bengaluru, India.
